Mr. Mime

Psychic Fairy

Kanto · Generation 1

Mr. Mime is a Psychic/Fairy-type Barrier Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 54.5 kg. It evolves from Mime Jr. and into Mr. Rime. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (120), with a base stat total of 460.
